limitations: This is an offline presentation model, not a native hook, SDK plugin, installer, or live-game validation.
All control IDs and values are demo data; native binding IDs, enum values, device names and conditional visibility are not reconstructed.
The Game map-player group hierarchy and some widget types require live observation; their captions are included but the preview arrangement is provisional.
Only the five requested tabs are covered. Staff, Input and Mods are outside scope.
